name: explain
sql:
explain (analyze, buffers, format text) 
with al as (
  select a.eval_at, a.player_a pa, a.player_b pb, a.side_player sp, fx.scheduled_start st,
         a.fixture_id::text fid, null::text eid
    from ten280_bot.alerts a left join public.kibl_fixtures fx on fx.fixture_id = a.fixture_id
   where a.mode = 'live' and a.eval_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => 24)
  union all
  select a.eval_at, a.player_a, a.player_b, a.side_player, ev.start_at, null::text, a.event_id::text
    from ten287_bot.alerts a left join ten287_rec.events ev on ev.event_id = a.event_id
   where a.mode = 'live' and a.eval_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => 24)
),
k as (
  select al.*, regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when pa like '%,%' then split_part(pa, ',', 1) else pa end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') ka, regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when pb like '%,%' then split_part(pb, ',', 1) else pb end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') kb, regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when sp like '%,%' then split_part(sp, ',', 1) else sp end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') ks from al
),
sel as (   -- one per selection: the players/side of its newest alert, any known ids
  select least(ka, kb) k1, greatest(ka, kb) k2, ks,
         (array_agg(pa order by eval_at desc))[1] pa, (array_agg(pb order by eval_at desc))[1] pb,
         (array_agg(sp order by eval_at desc))[1] sp, min(st) st, max(fid) fid, max(eid) eid
    from k where ka <> '' and kb <> '' and ka <> kb and ks in (ka, kb)
   group by 1, 2, 3
),
fx_c as (  -- Kibl fixtures in reach (bounded window), keyed once
  select f.fixture_id::text fixture_id, f.scheduled_start, f.player1_name, f.player2_name,
         least(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player1_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player1_name, ',', 1) else f.player1_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g'), regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player2_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player2_name, ',', 1) else f.player2_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')) k1,
         greatest(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player1_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player1_name, ',', 1) else f.player1_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g'), regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player2_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player2_name, ',', 1) else f.player2_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')) k2
    from public.kibl_fixtures f
   where f.scheduled_start >= now() - make_interval(hours => 24 + 24)
     and f.scheduled_start <  now() + interval '3 days'
),
ev_c as (
  select e.event_id::text event_id, e.start_at, e.home, e.away,
         least(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.home like '%,%' then split_part(e.home, ',', 1) else e.home end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g'), regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.away like '%,%' then split_part(e.away, ',', 1) else e.away end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')) k1, greatest(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.home like '%,%' then split_part(e.home, ',', 1) else e.home end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g'), regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.away like '%,%' then split_part(e.away, ',', 1) else e.away end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')) k2
    from ten287_rec.events e
   where e.start_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => 24 + 24) and e.start_at < now() + interval '3 days'
     and coalesce(e.home, '') not like '%/%' and coalesce(e.away, '') not like '%/%'
),
m as (     -- the same match at each vendor: the alert's own id, else exactly one candidate
  select s.*,
    coalesce(s.fid, (select case when count(*) = 1 then min(c.fixture_id) end from fx_c c
                      where c.k1 = s.k1 and c.k2 = s.k2
                        and (s.st is null or abs(extract(epoch from c.scheduled_start - s.st)) < 43200))) kfx,
    coalesce(s.eid, (select case when count(*) = 1 then min(c.event_id) end from ev_c c
                      where c.k1 = s.k1 and c.k2 = s.k2
                        and (s.st is null or abs(extract(epoch from c.start_at - s.st)) < 43200))) kev
    from sel s
),
-- ── odds-api.io books (TEN-295's pre-match rule) ──
live_from as (
  select t.event_id::text event_id, min(least(coalesce(t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at), t.seen_at)) at
    from ten287_rec.ticks t where t.event_id::text in (select kev from m where kev is not null)
     and t.event_status is distinct from 'pending'
   group by 1
),
tk as (
  select m.k1, m.k2, m.ks, t.book, t.id, t.book_updated_at at,
         case when regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.home like '%,%' then split_part(e.home, ',', 1) else e.home end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = m.ks then t.back_home when regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.away like '%,%' then split_part(e.away, ',', 1) else e.away end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = m.ks then t.back_away end ps,
         case when regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.home like '%,%' then split_part(e.home, ',', 1) else e.home end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = m.ks then t.back_away when regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.away like '%,%' then split_part(e.away, ',', 1) else e.away end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = m.ks then t.back_home end po
    from m
    join ten287_rec.ticks t on t.event_id::text = m.kev
    join ten287_rec.events e on e.event_id = t.event_id
    left join live_from lf on lf.event_id = m.kev
   where t.market = 'ML' and t.event_status = 'pending' and t.book_updated_at is not null
     and t.book = any ((select c.books from ten287_rec.config c where c.id))
     and (lf.at is null or t.book_updated_at < lf.at)
     and regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.home like '%,%' then split_part(e.home, ',', 1) else e.home end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') <> regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when e.away like '%,%' then split_part(e.away, ',', 1) else e.away end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')
),
-- ── Bet105 (Kibl poller, the drop bot's own feed) ──
ko as (
  select m.k1, m.k2, m.ks, 'Bet105'::text book, o.id, o.inserted_on at,
         o.side_id, o.price_decimal px,
         case when regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player1_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player1_name, ',', 1) else f.player1_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = m.ks then 2 when regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player2_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player2_name, ',', 1) else f.player2_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = m.ks then 3 end side_s
    from m
    join public.kibl_fixtures f on f.fixture_id::text = m.kfx
    join public.kibl_line_observations o on o.fixture_id = f.fixture_id
   where o.market_type_id = 1 and o.segment_id = 1 and o.feed_source_id = 171 and o.betting_type_id = 1
     and o.is_live is false and o.price_decimal >= 1.01 and o.inserted_on is not null
     and regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player1_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player1_name, ',', 1) else f.player1_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') <> regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(case when f.player2_name like '%,%' then split_part(f.player2_name, ',', 1) else f.player2_name end, ''), '^.*\s', '')), '[^a-z]', '', 'g')
),
pts as (   -- one stream of (selection, book, which side, time, price)
  select k1, k2, ks, book, id, at, 's' w, ps px from tk where ps >= 1.01
  union all select k1, k2, ks, book, id, at, 'o', po from tk where po >= 1.01
  union all select k1, k2, ks, book, id, at, case when side_id = side_s then 's' else 'o' end, px from ko where side_s is not null
),
chg as (   -- same-price re-stamps collapse
  select *, lag(px) over (partition by k1, k2, ks, book, w order by at, id) prev from pts
),
kept as (
  select *, row_number() over (partition by k1, k2, ks, book, w order by at desc, id desc) rn,
            first_value(px) over (partition by k1, k2, ks, book, w order by at, id) first_px,
            first_value(at) over (partition by k1, k2, ks, book, w order by at, id) first_at
    from chg where prev is distinct from px
),
per_side as (
  select k1, k2, ks, book, w, min(first_px) first_px, min(first_at) first_at,
         coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(at, round(px::numeric, 3)) order by at, id)
                    filter (where rn <= 400 and at >= now() - make_interval(hours => 24)), '[]'::jsonb) series
    from kept group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),
per_book as (
  select k1, k2, ks, book,
         jsonb_build_object(
           'source', case when book = 'Bet105' then 'Kibl' else 'odds-api.io' end,
           'first', (select jsonb_build_array(p.first_at, round(p.first_px::numeric, 3)) from per_side p
                      where p.k1 = b.k1 and p.k2 = b.k2 and p.ks = b.ks and p.book = b.book and p.w = 's'),
           'side',  coalesce((select p.series from per_side p where p.k1 = b.k1 and p.k2 = b.k2 and p.ks = b.ks and p.book = b.book and p.w = 's'), '[]'::jsonb),
           'other', coalesce((select p.series from per_side p where p.k1 = b.k1 and p.k2 = b.k2 and p.ks = b.ks and p.book = b.book and p.w = 'o'), '[]'::jsonb)
         ) j
    from (select distinct k1, k2, ks, book from per_side) b
)
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'key', s.k1 || '|' || s.k2 || '|' || s.ks, 'playerA', s.pa, 'playerB', s.pb, 'side', s.sp,
         'books', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(pb.book, pb.j) from per_book pb
                             where pb.k1 = s.k1 and pb.k2 = s.k2 and pb.ks = s.ks), '{}'::jsonb))
       order by s.k1, s.k2, s.ks), '[]'::jsonb)
  from sel s
